layout.fieldMinimumInlineSizeStatus: NOT SPECIFIED by current CSS; tracks and labels allow zero minimum

fields.layout: notes flexes; active checkbox stays beside it

sections.fieldIdsSource: data-field attributes in PersonsPage.tsx; nested group IDs identify existing rendered groups

capabilities.filteringAndCounts: client-side over the loaded persons collection

sections.count: filtered.length of persons.length; not a server-wide total contract

typography.fontSize: inherit --user-font-size preference; editor controls 14px, editor labels 10px, grid body 13px, grid headings 14px
typography.fontWeight: inherited unless current state or semantic element specifies emphasis

visualStatesObserved.hover: existing buttons, grid rows and controls have hover rules
visualStatesObserved.focus: existing input focus, focus-visible and focus-within rules
visualStatesObserved.selected: existing selected grid row and active footer action
visualStatesObserved.error: existing invalid-field, aria-invalid and field-error styles

languageAndDirection.zh: LTR; current Persons labels use the non-Persian language branch
languageAndDirection.numberInputs: existing number controls keep phone values LTR and address RTL

responsive.atOrBelow760px: Persons workspace retains 620px minimum width and scrolls horizontally; editor fields reflow to two columns
responsive.atOrBelow520px: editor fields reflow to one column
responsive.otherBehavior: existing grid/footer and application breakpoints remain authoritative

preferenceInheritanceObserved.themeAndFont: App applies the authenticated user's UserSettings preferences to the document root; form inherits existing CSS tokens and font variables
preferenceInheritanceObserved.personalGrid: column order, width and visibility use a user-keyed localStorage entry

keyboardContracts: formInteraction is installed once by main.tsx and owns global text focus selection, validated field navigation and F3 routing
F3 invokes the visible enabled save action in the focused form scope; the designer must not replace or intercept this contract
Persons view shortcuts use the configured new/edit/delete keys and Home/End/Page/arrow navigation
Persons edit mode uses the configured save key and Escape to cancel
futureConfigurationPrecedence: immutable Golden Form specification and existing host defaults
administrator form defaults, applying explicit properties only
the authenticated user's explicit per-property overrides
transient interaction states such as focus, error and disabled

futureReusableSections.editor: independently renderable field sections keyed by stable section and field IDs
futureReusableSections.grid: reuse the existing Excel grid implementation; Base Form does not introduce another grid
futureReusableSections.footer: independently renderable actions while preserving formInteraction and existing shortcuts

notImplemented: reusable Base Form renderer and visual Form Designer
direct field resizing, proportional resize weights, field drag/drop and group styling
live per-field color/typography preview and per-property overrides
administrator defaults and user-specific form layout persistence
isolated synthetic-data Form Laboratory and performance tests up to 100000 rows
